acceptance_criteria: [Relocated ancestor observed -> refusal and revert; ADR-0013 (b)] Whenever the backfill --policy-v2 run observes that a directory component it validated for a write target - the root, .ai, .ai/policies or .ai/drift - is no longer the same directory (moved, replaced, removed or turned into a symlink), before or after a write it performed, it refuses with the structured code path_relocated whose detail names the component; result is refused when, after this run's cleanup, no policy written by this run stands at the verified path - including a policy write this run removed or restored - and failed when this run's policy write stands at the verified path and the later ledger step refused (the base semantics of result); the exit code is 1 and stderr is non-empty; no code path reports written or exits 0 for a write that landed through an observed relocation, and a root that is observed gone is never recreated. Nothing this run wrote remains outside the root: a file this run created inside the relocated directory is removed while the entry is still this run's inode and the file holds exactly this run's bytes; a prior policy this run replaced is restored to its decision-time bytes under the same two conditions; bytes a competitor placed on this run's inode are never deleted or rewritten - the file is left as it is and the refusal is still reported; the relocated directory itself is the relocator's and is not claimed removed. Fixtures: T1 (policy directory relocated before the policy write - the converted deferred-to-ADR-0013 todo leg 1), T2 (ledger directory relocated before the ledger append - the converted todo leg 2), T3 (policy directory relocated inside the policy write, fresh root), T3b (as T3 with a v1 policy present: the original v1 bytes are restored), T4 (ledger directory relocated inside the ledger create), T5 (as T4 plus a competitor append on the created inode: the competitor's bytes survive the refusal), T7 (root replaced by a fresh directory before the policy write: path_relocated, the fresh root stays empty). The two node:test todo legs and their comment block are replaced by T1 and T2.

[Documented residual - ADR-0013 (c)] A relocation of a write directory that takes effect only inside the interval between the run's final verification and its write, and that is undone again before the run next verifies, is not observed: the run reports success (exit 0, result written) and the policy bytes are at the verified path inside the root. Conformance fixture T9 asserts exactly this and its name states that the interval is declared, not detected. The run is not required to detect or defeat that interval; the removal and restoration of AC-1 are best-effort controls, not guarantees, and are not claimed to be single kernel operations. Every text this goal writes states the residual in those terms, and none of them says race-free, cannot escape, never writes outside --root, or nothing outside --root is ever written. ADR-0013 is not edited: (c) remains the declared boundary; this goal changes only what is enforced inside it on this surface.

[Canonical caller root - ADR-0013 Depth of (a); SQ-1] A --root whose path reaches the repository through a symlinked ancestor (its lexical resolution differs from its canonical path) refuses with the structured code root_not_canonical whose detail names the canonical path to pass, exit 1, nothing written anywhere and no ledger line; BACKFILL_HELP and the src/backfill.ts docstring state the requirement (fixture T6). The existing root_symlinked, root_missing and root_not_directory fixtures keep their assertions.

[Structured reporting vocabulary] Every refusal of AC-1 and AC-3 is reported as a structured backfill report (result refused or failed; refusals[] entries with code and detail) with exit code 1 and a stderr line; no code path reports a silent success; an unexpected thrown error exits 1 with a stderr line. The observable backfill result codes gain exactly two members, path_relocated and root_not_canonical; every existing code - the 21 code: literals in src/backfill.ts at base (invalid, inventory_invalid, inventory_refused, inventory_unattributable, ledger_append_failed, path_changed, path_multiply_linked, path_not_directory, path_not_regular_file, path_symlinked, plan_in_flight, policy_unsupported, policy_v2_differs, root_missing, root_not_directory, root_symlinked, template_missing, template_unresolved_token, template_unsupported, unavailable, unreachable) - keeps its meaning and every existing test/backfill.test.ts assertion on them is unchanged. The evolve surface's observable refusal kinds (unsafe-path, layout-violation, write-once-violation, append-only-violation, schema-violation) keep their meanings, and every existing test/evolve-layout.test.ts assertion on them is unchanged.

[Claims discipline - ADR-0013 Compliance; historical red leg] The src/backfill.ts docstring, BACKFILL_HELP, the docstring of any file in scope this goal changes, .ai/evidence/FSC-C-01.json and the goal PR body state the enforced guarantee as exactly the outcomes of AC-1 and AC-3 and the residual of AC-2 in ADR-0013's terms. None of these texts contains race-free, cannot escape, never writes outside --root, or nothing outside --root is ever written; the phrases deferred residual and deferred-to-ADR-0013 no longer appear under src/ or test/. The behaviour of the policy and ledger write targets per entry class (regular file, symlink, hard link, directory, special file; replaced versus refused) is outside this goal's contract: it is described by the implementation's docstrings and asserted by its tests, and this goal neither widens nor narrows the existing fixtures that cover it. The over-claiming sentence in the registered ACH-C-04 acceptance text (writes nothing outside --root) is a registration-level item outside this goal's scope and is not repeated by any text this goal writes. .ai/evidence/FSC-C-01.json also carries the historical C-04 red leg required by annex section C-04 and the 2026-10-11T06:58Z successor amendment: the verbatim bytes of cure-race-red.log (4306 bytes, sha256 8dee1c6f72263f5cf370e7504e205050b0070303e5c6bff0837b7dc16cf99e11, recomputed at planning) under a historical_red_leg field with its provenance (root receipts .omc/plans/receipts-c04-impl-20261010/cure-race-red.log, C-04 cure round, 2026-10-11); no new scope path.
